subject: Additional credits request for Sidecar bake-off — top-up negotiation
messages:
From: Alex Bristow <alex.bristow@sidecarlabs.com>
To: aisha_rahman@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@sidecarlabs.com
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Additional eval credits for Sidecar bake-off (Sept)

Hi Aisha,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the model latency and token-cost breakdowns were really helpful. We’re running a time-boxed bake-off next week (Sidecar vs two incumbents) and need to push a broader set of prompts through longer contexts. Our initial allocation is likely to run out midway through the benchmark.

Can Redwood provide a one‑time top‑up of 50k generation tokens (or equivalent embedding units) scoped to the bake-off? We’ll run the suite over a 10‑day window and share the evaluation artifacts and a short write-up that summarizes performance vs cost.

Timeline: they want everything locked by Monday EOD so results can be included in the vendor review. We can route a PO if needed — procurement is copied. If there are any required forms or an addendum, please point me to them.

Attachments: Sidecar_Bakeoff_Scope.pdf (brief ops/metrics), SOW_draft.docx (internal).

Best,
Alex Bristow
Head of ML Integrations
Sidecar Labs
alex.bristow@sidecarlabs.com
From: aisha_rahman@redwood.com
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request: Additional eval credits for Sidecar bake-off (Sept)

Team — forwarding Sidecar's ask. Quick context: competing in an RFP-style bake-off against two incumbents; they want a one-time 50k token top-up to finish an extended scenario run.

Questions / suggested guardrails before I respond to them:
- Approvals: do we have discretionary eval credits at this tier (50k) without manager sign-off?
- Comms: require short write-up + permission to use anonymized results in our benchmarking folder; we should capture consent in email or an addendum.
- Timebox: limit to 10 days from grant; after that tokens expire.
- PO/doc: procurement will provide PO; we should send a credit addendum for signature.

I’m inclined to offer 40k credits with a 10-day window + ask for an on‑call review call if they hit issues. That gets them meaningful runway while keeping us conservative. Thoughts?

--
Aisha Rahman
Senior Account Executive, Strategic
Redwood Inference
aisha.rahman@redwood.com
From: aisha_rahman@redwood.com
To: Alex Bristow <alex.bristow@sidecarlabs.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Additional eval credits for Sidecar bake-off (Sept)

Hi Alex — thanks for the details and the scope deck. We want Sidecar to get a fair shot in the comparison.

We can approve a one‑time top‑up but with a few conditions:
- Token top‑up: 40,000 generation tokens (or equivalent embedding units).
- Window: credits valid for 10 calendar days from activation.
- Deliverable: a short results summary (1–2 pages) and confirmation that Redwood may store anonymized metrics from the bake-off for internal benchmarking.
- Admin: we’ll send a short Credit Addendum to be signed (DocuSign) and accept a PO from procurement for record-keeping.

If that works, I’ll trigger the addendum and activate the credits on receipt of the signed DocuSign (we can also provision on a signed email if procurement needs speed). I’ll CC Monica from CS so we can monitor any runtime issues (she’ll be on hand if they spike).

Links
- HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/342987
- Draft addendum (for reference): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0Bxyz

Attachments: Credit_Addendum.pdf (draft).

Next steps: please confirm acceptance by EOD and we’ll send the DocuSign link.

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Senior Account Executive, Strategic
Redwood Inference
aisha.rahman@redwood.com
From: Alex Bristow <alex.bristow@sidecarlabs.com>
To: aisha_rahman@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@sidecarlabs.com
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 14:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Additional eval credits for Sidecar bake-off (Sept)

Aisha — that sounds great, thanks. 40k with a 10‑day window and the addendum is acceptable. I’ll get procurement to sign the DocuSign tonight and we’ll return the 1–2 page results summary within 3 business days of the trial finishing. Appreciate the fast turnaround.

I’ll also attach the PO to the DocuSign envelope once it’s ready.

Regards,
Alex
